lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The service floor of the Steward's core opens onto a chamber, and the chamber has four centuries in it at once.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The 2031 lab courtyard is the floor. The 2064 atrium is the walls. The 2148 vault corridor runs through both of them at an angle that is not available. The lattice is the ceiling.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing has been removed to make room for anything else. They are simply all here, at the same time, and your eyes keep trying to choose one.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is not a Deep Site. A Deep Site is a place old enough that the eras touch, and you can step through, and it costs you something to do it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is a place where somebody has been standing in all four of them, continuously, for two hundred and twenty years. He has not travelled through time. He has simply refused to leave any of it, and the eras have worn together around him like a path across a lawn.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Entropy is not going to behave in here. Whatever the gauge tells you, be ready for it to be wrong in his favour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is a chair at the bottom. Four floors down. One of those floors is yours, and you have to walk through the other three to reach it.
